credit: Every figure shows edi's Co2SiO4 example (docs/user/cli/pd-neut-cwl_cosio-d20_2k): D20 neutron powder data at 2.3 K.

rendered.source: docs/user/cli/pd-neut-cwl_cosio-d20_2k (Co2SiO4, D20), fitted in the app
rendered.command: edi_app --demo OUTPUT --demo-only concepts- (each image saved by Save image at twice the size; the reduced pattern with every curve but the measured data hidden), then trimmed of empty margins; the structure's legend moved beside it

drawn.method: drawn by hand from the D20 geometry of that example: the (100) and (001) magnetic and the (221) nuclear reflections at lambda = 1.87 Angstrom; Noto Sans subset embedded; tick colours of the Main palette

computed.script: website/concepts-figures/final.py (with edicmap.py, the Blue-Red map in Oklab)
computed.data: website/concepts-figures/lo.npy: 2theta, intensity and s.u. of the measured D20 2.3 K pattern of that example
